The .SRCINFO file defines metadata for the `ttf-niek-fonts-mac` package, which is a font collection extracted from a GitHub release by the upstream author Niek. The source is a ZIP file hosted at `https://github.com/Niek/fonts-extractor/releases/download/v2.8/fonts-mac.zip`, a legitimate release endpoint for the stated GitHub repository. The package uses a standard, verifiable source with a matching SHA-256 checksum (`6ae7ff7cfef557675108b7447fab8848497dbadc7a788909feeba234be3701aa`), indicating integrity verification is performed. There are no signs of obfuscated URLs, suspicious network operations, or unexpected scripts.

The package depends only on `fontconfig`, which is typical for font packages on Arch Linux, and declares a custom license appropriate for font software. The `noextract` directive is used correctly to prevent premature extraction of the binary font archive, which will be handled in the PKGBUILD. All fields in the .SRCINFO conform to standard AUR packaging practices, and the source location is consistent with the declared upstream project. No dangerous or anomalous behaviors are present.

This file contains no executable code or commands, only declarative package metadata. As such, it cannot directly perform malicious actions. The use of a pinned release version and a valid checksum further reduces supply-chain risk. While the source is a prebuilt binary (ZIP of fonts), this is expected for a font package, and the checksum allows verification.
</details>
